rationale.complete: Round 1 done with per-period verdicts, synthetic validation and a scorecard; the frozen holdout test (#22, #28, #45) and the drive-vs-coupling kinetic model are not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (sign of J set by goal mode) failed (5/11 signs, D = 0) and no first-order consensus passed; only an effective ferromagnetic coupling beats the nulls (C = 1), and it is not separated from common drive.
rationale.usefulness: A robust 'herding is the default' finding and a cheap duplicated-work statistic from artifact links, but the 'assign ownership' design rule is post hoc (rho = -0.56, p = 0.04) and unconfirmed.

one_line: Agents herd onto shared projects in 11/14 weeks whatever the goal; spread appears only as fixed ownership.
